events.detail: FNF Construction Inc. (Contractor) is continuing with the reconstructing and improvement project on NM 404 and NM 213 from the roundabout to near the Texas state line. Crews will continue to implement temporary flagging and mobile traffic control as needed. NM 404 traffic is pushed to the inside lanes on the eastbound and westbound lanes for about a mile west of the roundabout. This will be in place for about four months as crews work on Phase I of construction. Traffic on NM 213 is shifted to the east, with crews working in the southbound lane and shoulders to install temporary barrier wall.
